map.分隔符取值：换行时按 \\r\\n / \\r / \\n 拆行，其余按字面分隔: Delimiter handling: with newline, split on \r\n / \r / \n; otherwise split on the literal delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab or a custom string) and drop newlines. The transform pipeline runs in order: dedupe (keep the first occurrence and accumulate the removed count), remove blank lines (filter out lines that are empty after trim), trim ends (replace ^\s+|\s+$ with nothing), sort (ascending/descending compare strings directly; natural sort uses Intl.Collator with numeric + base sensitivity, and when unavailable alternates numeric and text chunks comparing numbers numerically and text lexicographically, finally comparing the chunk count; sort by length compares length first, then lexicographically), reverse, add line numbers (padStart with zeros to the chosen width, then ". ") and remove line numbers (strip leading numbering such as `1. `, `2) ` or `3: `). Stats: original count (same source as the data actually processed), current count, accumulated dedupe count
